=IFERROR(__xludf.DUMMYFUNCTION("{""STT"",""Devices"";
LET(
  devs,FILTER(
    $D$2:$D1000,
    $D$2:$D1000<>"""",
    $D$2:$D1000<>""CISCO-NETWORK-SUB"",
    $D$2:$D1000<>""CISCO-ROUT-SUB""
  ),
  raw,REDUCE(
    """",
    devs,
    LAMBDA(acc,dev,
      LET(
        def,XLOOKUP(dev,$T$"&"2:$T1000,$U$2:$U1000,""""),
        adv,XLOOKUP(dev,$T$2:$T1000,$V$2:$V1000,""""),
        sdn,XLOOKUP(dev,$T$2:$T1000,$W$2:$W1000,""""),
        ful,XLOOKUP(dev,$T$2:$T1000,$X$2:$X1000,""""),

          acc,

    )
